name: Price & Cart Hider for WooCommerce
author: WooSofts

sections.description:
Price & Cart Hider for WooCommerce by Woosofts gives you complete control over how prices and Add to Cart buttons are displayed in your store. Whether you want to create a catalog-only site, hide pricing for guests, or offer private prices to select users — you can do it all effortlessly.

Main Features:
✅ Hide product prices based on flexible conditions
✅ Display custom text instead of prices (e.g., “Login to View Price”)
✅ Remove or hide the Add to Cart button
✅ Apply rules to specific products, categories, or tags
✅ Exclude specific products if needed
✅ Lightweight, fast, and easy to configure
✅ 100% compatible with most WooCommerce themes

No coding required — simply configure your rules and transform your store visibility!

Perfect for:
– Wholesale stores
– Catalog-only websites
– Membership-based shops
– Private B2B pricing setups

About Woosofts

Woosofts builds high-quality, lightweight, and powerful WooCommerce plugins to help you customize and scale your online store with ease.
Visit us at Woosofts.com for more tools and updates!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/price-cart-hider-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Price & Cart Hider to set up your visibility rules.
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices for specific products only?

Yes! You can target individual products, entire categories, or product tags.

Can I show a custom message instead of hiding the price?

Absolutely. Replace the hidden price with any custom text, like “Login to View Price” or “Contact Us for Pricing”.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, Price & Cart Hider is built to work seamlessly with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes! We built it with clean code and best practices to ensure top performance without slowing down your site.
